# Open Research Lab

Open Research Lab is the public research interface of Scientific OS. It publishes bounded Research Notes so humans and language models can understand, inspect, reproduce, challenge, and reuse a claim without treating automation or authorship as authority.

Canonical site: https://kbmt327-dev.github.io/scientific-os-research/
Japanese home: https://kbmt327-dev.github.io/scientific-os-research/ja/
English home: https://kbmt327-dev.github.io/scientific-os-research/en/

## Reading rules

- Japanese and English pages are parallel views of the same research object. Match them by `research_id`.
- Preserve scope. `Synthetic simulation`, `public trace measurement`, `contract validation`, and `protocol` are not interchangeable evidence classes.
- Read `What this research shows` together with `What this research does not show` (Japanese: `この研究が示すこと` / `この研究が示さないこと`).
- Treat `UNKNOWN` as an explicit evidence frontier, not as missing copy.
- A quick reproduction by the original repository is not an independent replication.
- Later notes may narrow earlier dated claims. Follow forward links and treat LATEST PUBLIC as the newest published boundary, not a claim that all private work is published.
